description: I’ve known Brian Fitzpatrick for over 20 years; I know his heart and his character. He is a quintessential Bucks Countian who represents us in Washington with enthusiasm and dedication. He has our values and our hopes. That is why I am voting Brian Fitzpatrick for Congress.
